notes.title: The Beast Update
notes.content:
DRILL RIFT UPDATE – THE BEAST RISES
A unique new encounter, UI improvements, and more!

Hey everyone!

First off, a huge thank you to everyone who played the demo and sent us feedback. Your thoughts have been incredibly helpful, and we’ve already put some of them into action.

This update brings one of the biggest additions yet: THE BEAST — a unique, punishing encounter that will test your planning and your dwarves’ sanity. Prepare to gain madness and face down a monster unlike anything else in the rift.

We’ve also reworked the Shipments UI, making it clearer and more noticeable, plus added warning systems so you’ll always know when a shipment is on the way.
[hr][/hr]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45702728/6e9e5796e1b35287a4ae32d5a59b20007b2f6765.png"]
🔨 Currently in the Works
Click-to-skip dice rolls for smoother pacing.

Tutorial improvements to help new players get started.

Balancing adjustments to accommodate the new monster encounter.

Sound settings rework so you can adjust button volume specifically.
[hr][/hr]📌 Planned Features
Items — new tools and resources to change how you approach the rift.

Localization — bringing Drill Rift to more languages worldwide.
[hr][/hr]
Thanks again for all your support — and keep that feedback coming. Every suggestion helps shape Drill Rift into the best game it can be.

ROCK AND STONE!
